title: ID0443937-DC/SI-D/IT-[Y2 / S1 313483122001] Zero Energy Session

additional_info.subject: 0443937 - ID0443937-DC/SI-D/IT-[Y2 / S1 313483122001] Zero Energy Session CRM:00314000218
additional_info.body:
Good afternoon Luigi,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0443937.
The ticket was opened for issues on Type2 charging outlet.
Today I had a call with Giuseppe, who follows in copy in this email, and the following points were clarified:
The charging sessions on Type2 outlet are referring to sessions on the AC outlet.
Last week (CW33), the EcoG KF12 was replaced on the charger, and the charger has now also the EcoG Hotfix v1.4.11
Giuseppe checked the charger and the sessions, and confirmed me that the charging sessions on CCS outlet are now successful, while we had and still have issues on the AC outlet.
The issues we are facing on the AC outlet are known, and are related to a communication error between PLC and AC meter. For this issue, we have a Hotfix tia 4.1.30, which I already installed.
All the outlets should be perfectly working now. I will move the ticket to the RC-T queue, where Giuseppe can monitor the charger performance in the next days in case any error is not solved.
Also, please be aware that both Hotfixes (EcoG 1.4.11 and TIA 4.1.30) will be included in the upcoming Sicharge D FW release v8.0.5, which will be officially released by the end of this current week.
Therefore, I am moving case 0443937 ﻿from the
Technical Support
to the
eMobility RC-IT SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s):

unified service process
.
